scope: Real Workspace owns fixed 66 retained file records and same Service; eight generated-loopback cases: actual worker-only local source lstat -> checked source stamp -> immutable review/upload for upload cases (stale same-size replacement refuses before remote partial creation), prepared download source/target selections go through actual read-only software review/pages/click-to-start, default no-replace and explicit re-review/replace; 32MiB upload/download continue after partial auth edit, parking/clearing, pane switch, fresh view rejecting late input, actual visible masked frontend submission, streaming directory refresh/hide and background pane switch; cancel case uses rendered task row and Cancel toolbar. Explicit cleanup/join, byte verification and retained Status parent-credit lifetime checked. Local test cat PTY with SSH profile reference/software canvas, not real SSH terminal/native window/IME/clipboard, source chooser/target text entry UI, fair latency/throughput, full-process memory cap or long/platform acceptance. No user SSH files or credentials. Path entry now uses a separately authenticated actual folder listing, selected raw remote name and its server-provided Version for downloads, fixed-limit protected local/filename fields for uploads, and actual next/review mouse controls. The directory sidebar is then hidden before the existing file-auth/background-switch sequence to avoid automatic directory loads on another pane. Initial directory challenge count is asserted separately; reported requests counts only subsequent file challenges.
